verdict.rationale: Smithery documents a managed connection layer that handles OAuth, token refresh and connection management, aggregates tools across servers, and offers deep links that auto-configure MCP clients. Community reports confirm Smithery-hosted servers whose tools agents reach on connect. However, no evidence explicitly shows a remote MCP endpoint URL that a developer pastes into an arbitrary MCP client, and the primary documented consumption path is a REST interface rather than native MCP. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a hosted remote MCP server URL format for direct client configuration, hands-on corroboration of connecting a generic MCP client with zero infrastructure.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point my MCP-compatible client at a hosted remote server URL and reach downstream tools without deploying any infrastructure

citations.quote: When a user clicks a deep link from our server page, the client automatically configures the MCP with the correct settings.
Smithery handles OAuth, token refresh, and connection management automatically.
Connect to multiple servers and aggregate their tools
You want to run a private tool for yourself or your team without hosting it.
